newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES END AT 28 PCT IN TIGHT SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES END AT 28 PCT IN TIGHT SUPPLY.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed higher on Tuesday as banks were making strong efforts to boost their mandatory reserves ahead of huge tax payments on December 20 and preparing for the year-end, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at around 28 percent, after opening at 26.50 percent.
"Tax advance payments on the 20th represent a huge amount of money," said Eniko Lederer of Citibank. "This will make Friday a very heavy day."
Another factor contributing to the tight supply was that banks would not be able to do any business on several days in the current two-week reserve period due to holidays.
